unit: Chromium viewport content pixels (not physical display size)
appliesTo: New browser test entrypoints introduced after legacyBaselineCommit
legacyPolicy: Previously existing tests and their original viewport cases are grandfathered; no source or evidence edits required
newTestPolicy: Use newDesktopContext for every Chromium context; no other viewport and no setViewportSize
layoutCoverage: At the fixed desktop size, check text wrapping, scrolling, unobstructed actions, and accessible math tools
evidencePolicy: Mathematics, correction, persistence, backup/restore, P10/offline, and required artifacts remain mandatory
